android.desc:
WeSpend: Personal Budget, Expense Tracker & Group Bill Splitter

Take full control of your money with WeSpend—the ultimate all-in-one personal finance tracker, shared budget manager, and group bill splitter. Whether managing offline personal expenses or splitting household bills and travel costs with friends, WeSpend keeps your money clear, secure, and organized.

Key Features:

100% Private Personal Budgeting: Keep your personal income and individual daily expenses completely private. Saved locally on your device with offline support.
Shared Budgets & Bill Splitting: Create collaborative group budgets with friends, roomies, or partners using email invitations. Set custom role permissions (Add, Edit, Delete) to manage group spending smoothly.
Borrow & Lend Ledger: Easily tag friends in IOUs, track debt, and know exactly who owes what without confusing spreadsheets.
Receipt Scanner & Cloud Storage: Attach receipt photos directly to any transaction so you never lose proof of payment.
Wealth & Savings Goals: Set individual or group savings milestones to achieve your financial targets together.
Live Chat & Activity Logs: Discuss group expenses, track real-time changes in the activity ledger, and stay informed with instant push notifications.
Multi-Currency Support: Switch between global currencies effortlessly for international trips and cross-border budgets.
Bank-Grade App Privacy: Protect your financial data with custom PIN, fingerprint biometric, and face lock options.
Monthly Financial Reports: Download comprehensive monthly income and expense reports in just one tap.

Stop juggling separate budgeting apps and bill splitters. Download WeSpend today to manage personal money privately and handle group expenses together!

quotes.title: I was tired of tracking expenses across 3 different apps, so I built WeSpend
